module: Flowgraph node "Zone by Name". Looks up a zone in sitesData.zones.byName. Inputs: flow, sitesData, zoneName; outputs: flow, exists (hidden), zone (zoneData).

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the node's internal state.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the node's custom properties in the flowgraph editor panel (ImGui).

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the flowgraph editor (ImGui).

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

work.desc: Looks up the zone by name, publishes zone and activates flow/exists if it exists and is not missing.
